thread:
Anya: Heads up — after yesterday's runtime dim-handshake tweak, we've started seeing a batch of 413s from a mobile client in prod. Repro attached and sample headers.
Mike: yikes. any specific client version or route?
Anya: route = /v1/embeddings, model=ada-embed-v2, client v2.4.1. Error payload: 
```
POST /v1/embeddings
Content-Type: application/json
X-Embed-Dims: 1536
Body: [ [0.1, 0.2, ...] ]  // single vector but client claims dims=1536
Response: 413 "payload shape mismatch"
```
Raj: probably the new handshake expects the client to declare dims and the router verifies vs shard-capacity. If they send inconsistent shapes we 413 to avoid runtime NPEs.
Sarah: Are these legitimately wrong vectors or just the header being set wrong by the mobile SDK?
Anya: looks like header is set by SDK default; actual body arrays are 512 floats. so header==1536 but body==512. SDK bug?
Kai: Hmm, two ways to handle: 1) strict reject (current) which prevents bad routing but breaks clients, 2) soft-accept + telemetry + route to fallback small-dim pool, 3) accept and auto-pad/trim (weird semantics).
Mike: We need an operationally safe quickfix. I propose: revert strict enforcement on ingress for 24h and enable a preflight telemetry counter for mismatched-dim events. Then force-sdk patch.
Raj: Revert is risky because it hides legit mismatches from our shard allocator. Could instead add a lightweight compatibility mode: if header != inferred_shape and request size < threshold, route to small-dim fastpath and flag telemetry. No padding.
Anya: Routing to small-dim pool without padding will still fail if runtime expects 1536 keys in kv cache. We need to guarantee runtime won't OOB.
Kai: True. But we can route to a compatibility worker built to serve generic dims by decoding the body and running a dimension-agnostic codepath (higher CPU cost). We already have a slow-path worker for off-nominal quantization cases.
Sarah: That sounds like more engineering than we can do immediately. For the hotfix let's do Mike's plan: toggle enforcement OFF on ingress, create a high-cardinality metric `embed.dim_mismatch_{route,client,env}` and an alert if >5% of requests from a client are mismatched. Also post a console note for affected customers.
Raj: Okay, but please add a sampling profiler for those requests so we can postmortem perf impact if this grows.
Mike: I'll open the rollback toggle PR and the metric PR. sampe code for the metric: 
```
// ingress preflight
if (header_dims != infer_dims(body)) {
  metrics.counter("embed.dim_mismatch").tag("client", client_id).inc();
  if (enforce_header) return HTTP_413;
}
```
Anya: Add tags: route, region, sdk_version. Also record a small example body hash (sha1) for debugging (sampled 0.1%).
ops-bot: deploy-toggle "ingress.enforce_header_dims" set to OFF in prod-6 for 24h by Mike at 2026-03-21T15:12:02Z
Kai: After toggle, let's run a quick canary: send mixed-dim requests from staging and verify we don't create silent correctness issues for downstream consumers.
Sarah: UX note for console: can we add a one-line banner on the embeddings route page with a count of recent dim-mismatch events and a link to the SDK issue? Product wants customers to self-diagnose before hitting support.
Mike: console-bot? (cc @product) we can plumb the metric to the route health panel — quick PR to show last 1h % mismatches.
Anya: Also please add a short-runbook in the metrics alert with steps: 1) identify client sdk_version 2) toggle enforcement 3) force patch & rollout 4) if >20% persistent, consider evolving runtime compatibility path.
Raj: For rollout longer-term, I'd prefer adding an explicit preflight endpoint: `POST /v1/embeddings/preflight` where clients send header dims + a small sample body and get an acceptance token. Router can use token to bypass heavy validation and mark client as trusted for short TTL. That reduces latency for repeated calls.
Kai: Preflight token sounds neat — reduces sha1 sampling and console noise. But it also opens token spoof risk; require API key binding.
Sarah: Ok can be a medium-term RFC. For now, get the hotfix, metrics, console banner, and SDK patch scheduled.
Anya: Thanks — I'll file the SDK issue and add a repro gist in the ticket. Rolling the toggle now and will report numbers in 30m.
Mike: thanks, team.
Anya: (later) 30m update: mismatch metric spiked from 0% -> 2.7% for that mobile client, error rate dropped to 0.2%. Leaving toggle off until we patch SDK.
